answer: Bind first earnings to time-stamped public work: on a new key's first payout, require a signed, independently reviewed code change in a repository with a proposed six-month activity history; accept one earning key per verified contributor fingerprint and reject reused fingerprints. A catalog patch tracking velvet and sable sales through their seasonal zenith could qualify. Proposed review fee: $0.10 per identity × 1,000 = $100, versus a proposed $0.10 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: wealthy attackers can buy convincing repositories and reviews.
